description: This file implements the HwcTester class, which interacts with the hardware composer to manage display configurations, create layers, and draw solid colors on screens for testing purposes within the Android graphics stack.

classes.name: HwcTester
classes.description: A class for testing hardware composer functionalities such as display configuration, layer creation, and drawing operations.

methods.name: HwcTester
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the hardware composer client and retrieves display information.

methods.name: ~HwcTester
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up display writers and releases the composer client.

methods.name: GetAllDisplayIds
methods.description: Returns a list of all display IDs managed by the tester.

methods.name: GetDisplayConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves available display configurations for a given display ID.

methods.name: GetDisplayActiveConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the active configuration for a specified display.

methods.name: DrawSolidColorToScreen
methods.description: Creates a layer and draws a solid color on the specified display.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Provides access to the command writer for a specific display.
